Name: Green Cute Furniture
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
UPDATE 1.1.0 (content patcher version... will have AT version up soon!) : Adds 6 sofas and 3 armchairs! Check out the 2nd picture to see the cuteness <3

Ah! Ok! So here is the 'Green Cute Furniture' series. It is the final version of the original 'Cute' series that i have planned to make at the moment. I will be updating the regular/green/desaturated versions of my 'Cute' series as I create more furniture for it <3 

[size=5]Both Content Patcher and Alternative Textures versions are availible in 'files' tab ─── ⋆｡°✩

[size=3]₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ I released [url=https://youtu.be/mU9H2whIVm4]THIS youtube video[/url] showcasing the Cute Furniture Series![/size][size=3]! Check it out if you desire <3  ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊[/size]

[/size]︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶⠀୨♡୧⠀︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶
[size=4][i][b]What's new in this mod??[/b][/i][/size]
Ok so I LOVE green, its my favourite colour, and I wanted to create 3 colour palettes (blue-green, green, and yellow-green) of all of my cute series furniture! So, our blue-green shade is called "Emerald", green is "Lime" and yellow-green is "Pickle" ٩(^ᗜ^ )و ´-

~EXCLUSIVE FURNITURE TO THIS MOD~
I have 4 versions of the double bed- Butterfly, Cozy, and Quilt (which can be seen in the other Cute mods), but exclusive to this mod is "Froggy" double bed! It matches the child frog bed that i thought was so cute I had to make more of <3 

Also exclusive to this mod is a rug called "Patchwork Rug". I love this one.... so flippin cute <3 different frog/flower/pattern motifs are on each version.

So all in all, so far it is 15 rugs, and 72 beds (double/single/child)
︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶⠀୨♡୧⠀︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶

[size=2]How to install:[/size]
[size=2]1. ensure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher OR Alternative Textures installed[/size]
[size=2]2. download my file (whichever you prefer- AT or CP)[/size]
[size=2]3. unzip the file into your 'Mods' folder[/size]
[size=2]you will now have cute green furniture in your game!![/size]
